meaning/line.why: Changed is right. X puts it at severity 3, but sheep->cheap is a wrong detail (2), not a number or party. Y has the right severity but calls sheep/cheap 'homophones', which they are not quite.

noticeable.why: 'stark countryside, just cheap and a single house' does not make sense, so a careful reader would notice. X says no.

stakes.why: A casual description of scenery; the slip is odd but unlikely to mislead anyone. X says yes while calling the result 'nonsensical', which points the other way. Y's no is sensible.

rule.why: Different content word; 3 of 4 others wrote 'sheep' (Granite did not). Both say yes.

rank.why: At the spot the three 'sheep' engines are equal and the two 'cheap' engines are equal. Y splits the 'sheep' engines over stock/stark, which is outside the spot (and 'stark' is likely what was said).

misses.why: Both find the garbled 'for choice ... very cute in the countryside' and sheep->cheap. X adds stock/stark and Y adds the dropped 'do you', both trivial. Y's severity 3s are a little high.

overall.why: Y gets noticeable, stakes and the line severity right where X slips; X's only win is a cleaner rank.
